name: Maria da Luz Santos
bio: Maria's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years working as a metalworker in Lisbon, a chance encounter with a rally team needing urgent repairs during a local race ignited her passion. Her skills quickly became invaluable, and she transitioned to a full-time role within the motorsport industry. Maria believes in a hands-on, meticulous approach to fabrication, prioritizing quality and precision above all else. She's known for her ability to diagnose and solve complex structural issues, often finding ingenious solutions where others see only problems. Her pragmatic nature allows her to remain calm under pressure and deliver consistent results, even in the most demanding situations. She is now a fabricator at Rahal Letterman Lanigan.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often pulled back with a bandana while working
physical.description: A sturdy woman with strong hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her welding tools before starting a new task.
Insists on using traditional hand tools alongside modern equipment.
Has a lucky wrench she's carried with her for over 20 years.
